policies.title: Mauritanian ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's actively linked April 2024 Embassy schedule places Mauritania in its Prior to Arrival visa category.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Mauritanian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a Grenada mission or consulate before travel.
The schedule is actively linked but was updated April 2024; recheck if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service and special-document routes remain outside scope.

policies.title: Mauritanian ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule expressly places Mauritania in the authorized-visa cohort, requiring advance consular approval unless its separate third-country-document waiver applies.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Mauritanian passport holder travelling as a short visitor who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
Submit the authorized-visa application and listed documents to the competent Panamanian consulate before travel; the Embassy says approval may take up to 60 business days.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, consular-jurisdiction requirements and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Panama Embassy authorized-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Up to 60 business days, depending on document verification and completion.
steps: Determine that Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver does not apply.
Submit the listed authorized-visa documents to the competent Panamanian consulate before travel.
Travel only after the consular visa has been granted and carry all required supporting documents.

policies.title: Mauritanian ordinary passports: Gambia reciprocal visa waiver
policies.summary: Mauritania's current Foreign Affairs Ministry lists Gambia among reciprocal visa-suppression agreements without a special-passport limitation.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Mauritanian passport holder travelling for a short visit.
The Ministry separately identifies agreements limited to diplomatic, service or official passports; it does not attach that limitation to Gambia.
Duration, work, residence, transit, carrier checks and final admission remain outside this classification.
